reason: Both responses correctly identify the same four core defects (WHERE clause defeating the LEFT JOIN, UTC vs UTC+8 boundary mismatch, integer division truncation, and NULL total_spent for zero-order customers with its NULL-ordering side effect), but Response A packages the ordering side effect together with its root cause instead of padding it into a separate, redundant fifth bullet, and it gives concrete, ready-to-use SQL fixes for every point (including two alternative fixes for the timezone issue), making it slightly more actionable without adding unnecessary length.
